### 5.0 Perform gene set enrichment

- Perform gene set enrichment of proteins using `enrichr`

```{r}

protein_split <- split(significant_events_df, significant_events_df$comparison)
protein_split <- protein_split[c("VCP_CTRL_vs_CTRL_CTRL", "VCP_ERAP2_vs_CTRL_ERAP2")]

dbs <- "GO_Biological_Process_2023"
groups <- names(protein_split)
directions <- c("up", "down")
kd_geneset_enrichment_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(groups, function(a_group){
    a_temp_df <- protein_split[[a_group]]
    return_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(directions, function(a_direction){
            db_df_list <- lapply(dbs, function(a_database){
                message(paste(a_database, a_direction, a_group))
                current_fcs <- a_temp_df$logfc[a_temp_df$direction == a_direction]
                current_genes <- a_temp_df$protein_name[a_temp_df$direction == a_direction]
                an_enrichment_df <- enrichr(current_genes,  a_database)[[1]]
                if(nrow(an_enrichment_df) == 0){
                    return(NULL)
                }
                an_enrichment_df$direction <- a_direction
                an_enrichment_df$num_gene <- length(current_genes)
                an_enrichment_df$db <- a_database
                Sys.sleep(5)
                return(an_enrichment_df)
            })
            db_df <- do.call(rbind, db_df_list)
        }))
    return_df$contrasts <- a_group
    return(return_df)
}))

kd_geneset_enrichment_df$gene_ratio <- vapply(kd_geneset_enrichment_df$Overlap, function(x){
    eval(parse(text = x))
},1)


significant_gene_set_enrichment <- kd_geneset_enrichment_df[kd_geneset_enrichment_df$P.value < 0.05,]


pdf(file = file.path(plot_dir, "03-01-gene-set-enrichments-for-differentially-enriched-proteins.pdf"))
groups <- unique(kd_geneset_enrichment_df$contrasts)
directions <- c("up", "down")
lapply(unique(kd_geneset_enrichment_df$db), function(a_database){
    lapply(groups, function(a_group){
        lapply(directions, function(a_direction){
            message(a_group, a_database)
            current_n <- unique(kd_geneset_enrichment_df[
                kd_geneset_enrichment_df$contrasts == a_group &
                kd_geneset_enrichment_df$direction == a_direction &
                kd_geneset_enrichment_df$db == a_database, "num_gene"])
            plot_df <- kd_geneset_enrichment_df[kd_geneset_enrichment_df$P.value < 0.05 &
                kd_geneset_enrichment_df$contrasts == a_group &
                kd_geneset_enrichment_df$db == a_database &
                kd_geneset_enrichment_df$direction == a_direction,]
            if(nrow(plot_df) > 0){
                plotEnrich(plot_df, showTerms = 10, numChar = 50, y = "Ratio", orderBy = "Combined.Score", title = paste(a_database, paste("\n",a_group), a_direction, "N=",current_n))
            }else{
                return(NULL)
            }
        })
    })
})
dev.off()
```

- Perform GSEA for treatment and condition effects

```{r}

require("msigdbr")
require("fgsea")
require("parallel")
require("hypeR")

.handle.genesets <- function(genesets) {
    if (is(genesets, "list")) {
        gsets.obj <- gsets$new(genesets, quiet=TRUE)
    }
    else if (is(genesets, "gsets") | is(genesets, "rgsets")) {
        gsets.obj <- genesets
    } 
    else {
        stop("Genesets must be gsets/rgsets object or named list of genesets")
    }
    return(gsets.obj)
}

fgsea.wrapper <- function(signature, genesets, sample.size=101, min.size=1, max.size=Inf, ...) {
    # Save original arguments
    args <- as.list(environment())
    
    # Save gsets object
    gsets.obj <- .handle.genesets(genesets)
    args$genesets <- gsets.obj
    
    # Run fgsea
    results <- fgsea::fgseaMultilevel(stats=signature, 
                                      pathways=gsets.obj$genesets, 
                                      sampleSize=sample.size, 
                                      minSize=min.size, 
                                      maxSize=max.size, 
                                      ...)
    data <- results %>%
        data.frame() %>%
        plyr::rename(c("pathway"="label", "padj"="fdr", "log2err"="lte", "size"="overlap", "leadingEdge"="le")) %>%
        dplyr::rename_with(tolower) %>%
        mutate(pval=signif(pval, 2)) %>%
        mutate(fdr=signif(fdr, 2)) %>%
        mutate(le=sapply(le, function(x) paste(x, collapse=','))) %>%
        mutate(signature=length(signature)) %>%
        mutate(geneset=sapply(label, function(x) length(gsets.obj$genesets[[x]]))) %>%
        dplyr::select(c("label", "pval", "fdr", "lte", "es", "nes", "signature", "geneset", "overlap", "le"))
    
    data.up <- data %>%
        dplyr::filter(es > 0) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(pval, es)

    data.dn <- data %>%
        dplyr::filter(es < 0) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(pval, es)    

    # Reproducibility information
    info <- list(fgsea=paste("v", packageVersion("fgsea"), sep=""),
                 signature=length(signature), 
                 genesets=args$genesets$info())
    
    info <- c(info, args[c("sample.size", "min.size", "max.size")])
    info <- lapply(info, as.character)
    
    # Wrap dataframe in hyp object
    hyp.up <- hyp$new(data=data.up, args=args, info=info)
    hyp.dn <- hyp$new(data=data.dn, args=args, info=info)
    mhyp <- multihyp$new(data=list("up"=hyp.up, "dn"=hyp.dn))
    return(mhyp)
}
```

- fetch metabolite information


```{r}

require("hmdbQuery")
require("httr")


extract_dataframe <- function(object){
    up_object <- object$data$up$data
    up_labels <- up_object[up_object$pval < 0.05 & !is.na(up_object$pval),"label"]
    up_ids <- vapply(str_extract_all(string = up_labels, pattern = "(?<=\\()(.*?)(?=\\))"), function(x){x[length(x)]},"1")
    down_object <- object$data$dn$data
    dn_labels <- down_object[down_object$pval < 0.05 & !is.na(down_object$pval),"label"]
    dn_ids <- vapply(str_extract_all(string = dn_labels, pattern = "(?<=\\()(.*?)(?=\\))"), function(x){x[length(x)]},"1")

    all_df <- rbind(
        up_object[up_object$pval < 0.05 & !is.na(up_object$pval),], 
        down_object[down_object$pval < 0.05 & !is.na(down_object$pval),])
    all_ids <- c(up_ids, dn_ids)
    all_df$ids <- all_ids
    return(all_df)
}

metabolite_list <- lapply(conditional_differentially_expressed_with_entrez_split, function(temp_df){
    a_vector <- temp_df$logfc
    names(a_vector) <- temp_df$protein_name
    mhyp_obj <- fgsea.wrapper(a_vector, hmdb_metabolites)
})

HMDB_entry_list <- lapply(metabolite_list, function(temp_object){
    up_object <- temp_object$data$up$data
    up_labels <- up_object[up_object$pval < 0.05,"label"]
    up_ids <- vapply(str_extract_all(string = up_labels, pattern = "(?<=\\()(.*?)(?=\\))"), function(x){x[length(x)]},"1")
    down_object <- temp_object$data$dn$data
    dn_labels <- down_object[down_object$pval < 0.05,"label"]
    dn_ids <- vapply(str_extract_all(string = dn_labels, pattern = "(?<=\\()(.*?)(?=\\))"), function(x){x[length(x)]},"1")


    all_df <- rbind(up_object, down_object)
    all_ids <- c(up_ids, dn_ids)
    all_df$hmdb_ids <- all_ids

    entry_list <- lapply(all_ids, function(x){
        # if(str_length(x) < 11){
        #     sub_id <- str_sub(string = x, start = 5, end = str_length(x))
        #     new_id <- paste("HMDB", paste(rep(0, 11 - (4+str_length(sub_id))), collapse = ""), sub_id, sep = "")
        # }
        message(x)
        active_url <- GET(paste("http://www.hmdb.ca/metabolites/", x, sep = "/"))[["url"]]
        new_id <- basename(active_url)
        err <- T
        while(err == T){
            try_out <- try(expr = HmdbEntry(prefix = "http://www.hmdb.ca/metabolites/", 
               id = new_id, keepFull = T))
            if(class(try_out) %in% "HmdbEntry"){
                err <- F
            }
        }
        return(try_out)
    })
    names(entry_list) <- all_ids

    entry_list
})

metabolite_and_hmdb_entry_list <- lapply(seq_along(metabolite_list), function(x){
    temp_object <- metabolite_list[[x]]
    sig_metabolite_df <- extract_dataframe(temp_object)
    entry_list <- HMDB_entry_list[[x]]
    list(enriched_metabolites = sig_metabolite_df, hmdb_entries = entry_list)
})

saveRDS(object = metabolite_and_hmdb_entry_list, file = file.path(save_dir, "03-metabolite-and-hmdb-entries-together.rds"))
```

- compute jaccard index

```{r}

require("factoextra")
require("NbClust")

make_similarity_index <- function(x_list, y_list){
    a_matrix <- matrix(data = 0, nrow = length(y_list), ncol = length(x_list))
    pairs_matrix <- cbind(
        y = rep(x = seq_len(nrow(a_matrix)), times = ncol(a_matrix)), 
        x = rep(x = seq_len(ncol(a_matrix)), each = nrow(a_matrix)))
    similarity_value <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs_matrix)), function(x){
        all_y <- do.call(c, y_list)
        current_y <- y_list[[ pairs_matrix[x,"y"] ]]
        all_x <- do.call(c, x_list)
        current_x <- x_list[[ pairs_matrix[x,"x"] ]]

        intersect_length <- length(intersect(current_x, current_y))
        # union_of_all <- union(all_x, all_y)

        # in_x_and_y <- length(union_of_all[union_of_all %in% current_x & union_of_all %in% current_y])
        # in_x_not_y <- length(union_of_all[(union_of_all %in% current_x) & !(union_of_all %in% current_y)])
        # in_y_not_x <- length(union_of_all[!(union_of_all %in% current_x) & (union_of_all %in% current_y)])
        # not_in_y_and_x <- length(union_of_all[!(union_of_all %in% current_x) & !(union_of_all %in% current_y)])

        # cont_matrix <- matrix(data = c(in_x_and_y, in_x_not_y, in_y_not_x, not_in_y_and_x), nrow = 2, ncol = 2)

        # fisher.test(cont_matrix, alternative = "greater")$p.value
        return(intersect_length / length(current_x))
    },1)
    a_matrix[pairs_matrix] <- similarity_value
    return_matrix <- t(a_matrix)
    return(return_matrix)
}

metabolite_and_hmdb_entry_list <- readRDS(file.path(save_dir, "03-metabolite-and-hmdb-entries-together.rds"))
clustered_similarity_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(metabolite_and_hmdb_entry_list), function(x){
    enriched_metabolites_df <- metabolite_and_hmdb_entry_list[[x]]$enriched_metabolites
    enriched_bp_df <- biological_process_list[[x]]
    enriched_cc_df <- cellular_component_list[[x]]
    enriched_mf_df <- molecular_function_list[[x]]

    enriched_metabolites_df$db <- "HMDB"
    enriched_bp_df$db <- "GO:BP"
    enriched_cc_df$db <- "GO:CC"
    enriched_mf_df$db <- "GO:MF"

    all_enriched_df <- rbind(enriched_metabolites_df, 
        enriched_bp_df, enriched_cc_df, enriched_mf_df)

    gene_list <- str_split(string = all_enriched_df$le, pattern = ",")
    similarity_matrix <- make_similarity_index(gene_list, gene_list)

    # metabo_gene_list <- str_split(string = enriched_metabolites_df$le, pattern = ",")
    # bp_gene_list <- str_split(string = enriched_bp_df$le, pattern = ",")
    # cc_gene_list <- str_split(string = enriched_cc_df$le, pattern = ",")
    # mf_gene_list <- str_split(string = enriched_mf_df$le, pattern = ",")

    # metabo_bp_matrix <- make_similarity_index(metabo_gene_list, bp_gene_list)
    # metabo_cc_matrix <- make_similarity_index(metabo_gene_list, cc_gene_list)
    # metabo_mf_matrix <- make_similarity_index(metabo_gene_list, mf_gene_list)

    # metabo_bp_zscore_matrix <- t((t(metabo_bp_matrix) - mean(metabo_bp_matrix)) / sd(metabo_bp_matrix))
    # metabo_cc_zscore_matrix <- t((t(metabo_cc_matrix) - mean(metabo_cc_matrix)) / sd(metabo_cc_matrix))
    # metabo_mf_zscore_matrix <- t((t(metabo_mf_matrix) - mean(metabo_mf_matrix)) / sd(metabo_mf_matrix))

    clustering <- hclust(as.dist(1 - similarity_matrix), method = "ward.D2")
    all_cluster_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq(from = 3, to = 100), function(y){
        clusters <- cutree(clustering, y)
        cluster_split <- split(seq_len(nrow(similarity_matrix)), clusters)
        cluster_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cluster_split, function(y1){
            current_matrix <- similarity_matrix[y1, y1]
            sub_matrix <- current_matrix[upper.tri(current_matrix, diag = F)]
            return(data.frame(hmdb_present = "HMDB" %in% unique(all_enriched_df$db[y1]),
                num_db = length(unique(all_enriched_df$db[y1])),
                cluster_size = length(y1), 
                mean_similarity = mean(sub_matrix), 
                prop_zeros = length(sub_matrix[sub_matrix == 0]) / length(sub_matrix)))
        }))
        cluster_df$tree_level <- y
        cluster_df$cluster <- as.numeric(names(cluster_split))
        return(cluster_df)
    }))
    keep_clusters_df <- all_cluster_df[all_cluster_df$hmdb_present & all_cluster_df$mean_similarity != 0,]
    selected_hmdb_to_term_map_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(unique(keep_clusters_df$tree_level), function(y){
        current_row <- keep_clusters_df[keep_clusters_df$tree_level == y,]
        clusters <- cutree(clustering, y)
        cluster_split <- split(seq_len(nrow(all_enriched_df)), clusters)
        cluster_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(current_row$cluster, function(y1){
            current_enriched_df <- all_enriched_df[cluster_split[[y1]],]
            current_matrix <- similarity_matrix[cluster_split[[y1]], cluster_split[[y1]]]
            rownames(current_matrix) <- current_enriched_df$ids
            colnames(current_matrix) <- current_enriched_df$ids
            melt_df <- reshape2::melt(current_matrix)
            colnames(melt_df) <- c("xaxis", "yaxis", "similarity")
            melt_df$x_db <- current_enriched_df$db[match(melt_df$xaxis, current_enriched_df$ids)]
            melt_df$y_db <- current_enriched_df$db[match(melt_df$yaxis, current_enriched_df$ids)]
            return(melt_df)
        }))
    }))

    unique_df <- unique(selected_hmdb_to_term_map_df[selected_hmdb_to_term_map_df[,1] != selected_hmdb_to_term_map_df[,2] & 
        selected_hmdb_to_term_map_df[,"x_db"] == "HMDB" & 
        selected_hmdb_to_term_map_df[,"y_db"] != "HMDB" &
        selected_hmdb_to_term_map_df[,"similarity"] != 0,])
    unique_df$x_nes <- all_enriched_df$nes[match(unique_df$xaxis, all_enriched_df$ids)]
    unique_df$x_direction <- ifelse(unique_df$x_nes < 0, "down", "up")
    unique_df$y_nes <- all_enriched_df$nes[match(unique_df$yaxis, all_enriched_df$ids)]
    unique_df$y_direction <- ifelse(unique_df$y_nes < 0, "down", "up")
    unique_df$xlabel <- all_enriched_df$label[match(unique_df$xaxis, all_enriched_df$ids)]
    unique_df$ylabel <- all_enriched_df$label[match(unique_df$yaxis, all_enriched_df$ids)]
    unique_df$condition <- names(conditional_differentially_expressed_with_entrez_split)[x]
    return(unique_df)
}))
```

- plot clustering results


```{r}

clustered_similarity_df$lipid_group <- lipid_groups[clustered_similarity_df$xaxis]
clustered_similarity_df$lipid_group[is.na(clustered_similarity_df$lipid_group)] <- ""
clustered_similarity_df$xaxis <- paste(clustered_similarity_df$lipid_group, clustered_similarity_df$xaxis, sep = "|")
clustered_similarity_df$yaxis <- paste(clustered_similarity_df$y_db, clustered_similarity_df$yaxis, sep = "|")


use_theme <- theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 90, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "azure3",
        linetype = "dashed",
        size = 0.2))



lapply(split(clustered_similarity_df, clustered_similarity_df$condition), function(temp_df){
    message(unique(temp_df$condition))
    xaxis_similarity <- vapply(split(temp_df$similarity, temp_df$xaxis), median, 1)
    temp_df$xaxis <- factor(temp_df$xaxis, levels = names(xaxis_similarity)[order(xaxis_similarity, decreasing = T)])
    
    yaxis_similarity <- vapply(split(temp_df$similarity, temp_df$yaxis), median, 1)
    ylabel_similarity <- vapply(split(temp_df$similarity, temp_df$ylabel), median, 1)
    temp_df$yaxis <- factor(temp_df$yaxis, levels = names(yaxis_similarity)[order(yaxis_similarity, decreasing = T)])
    temp_df$ylabel <- factor(temp_df$ylabel, levels = names(ylabel_similarity)[order(ylabel_similarity, decreasing = T)])

    keep_temp_df <- temp_df[temp_df$lipid_group != "",]
    keep_temp_df_split <- split(keep_temp_df, keep_temp_df$y_db)

    plot_temp_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(keep_temp_df_split, function(x2){
        return(x2[order(abs(x2$y_nes),decreasing = T),][1:10,])
    }))

    ThePlot <- ggplot(plot_temp_df, aes(x = ylabel, y = y_nes))
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_point(aes(fill = y_nes), colour = "#000000", shape = 21)
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_x_discrete("GO Terms")
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_y_continuous("Normalised enrichment score")
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_fill_distiller("nes", palette = "RdBu", direction = 1)
    # ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_size_continuous("similarity", limits = c(0,1))
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + theme_bw()
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + ggtitle(unique(temp_df$condition))
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + facet_grid(. ~ y_db)
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + use_theme
    ggsave(width = 20, height = 20, file = file.path(plot_dir, paste("07-01" , unique(temp_df$condition), 
        "plot-nes-of-go-terms.pdf")), ThePlot)

    ThePlot <- ggplot(plot_temp_df, aes(x = xaxis, y = yaxis))
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_point(aes(fill = similarity, size = similarity), colour = "#000000", shape = 21)
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_x_discrete("HMDB metabolites")
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_y_discrete("GO terms")
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_fill_distiller("similarity", palette = "YlOrRd", direction = 1, limits = c(0,1))
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_size_continuous("similarity", limits = c(0,1))
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + theme_bw()
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + ggtitle(unique(temp_df$condition))
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + facet_grid(y_db ~ .)
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + use_theme
    ggsave(width = 10, height = 20, file = file.path(plot_dir, paste("07-01", unique(temp_df$condition), 
        "plot-similarity-between-hmdb-metabolites-and-go-terms.pdf")), ThePlot)
})
```
